description:
Native Memos client with task management and a typography-first design
Nikki is a native Android client for Memos, the open-source self-hosted note-taking tool. It adds structured task management on top of your memos, with a flat, typography-first interface.

Tasks are parsed directly from markdown checkboxes in your notes. Write "- [ ] buy milk tomorrow 5pm p1 #shopping" and Nikki extracts the due date, time, priority, and tags — giving you a structured task view without duplicating data.

Features:
• Full Memos API integration (create, edit, pin, archive, delete)
• Rich markdown rendering with code highlighting, tables, and links
• Server-side link previews for URLs in memos
• Share links for public access to individual memos
• Emoji reactions and comments
• Configurable feed truncation with date gutter layout
• Due dates, times, priorities (p1-p3), reminders, tags
• Group and sort tasks by date, priority, list, or memo
• Filter tasks by source memo
• Color-coded task urgency (overdue, today, priority)
• Android notifications with 4 priority channels
• Calendar integration for reliable reminders
• Offline-first with sync queue
• 3 themes (dark, light, AMOLED) and 20 accent colors
• Activity calendar, tag browser, and search
• Export/import backup as JSON
• Share text from any app into a new memo

Requires a running Memos instance (v0.22+, v0.31 recommended). The name comes from the Japanese word 日記 (nikki), meaning diary.
